text:
cleo: quick note — found inconsistent env var names across sample repos: some use RW_API_KEY, others REDWOOD_API_KEY, and a few still have RW_TOKEN. new devs keep getting 401s.
dan: ouch. do SDKs agree on scope precedence (project/org/account)?
cleo: nope. python prefers project -> org -> account, node prefers org -> account, go just uses account unless RW_SCOPE present.
peggy: that's messy. proposal: canonical vars REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_SCOPE (format project:<id> or org:<id>), SDKs should parse those only and warn on old names.
dan: also need a rotation story — CI uses short-lived secrets and SDKs currently read env once and cache forever. we saw nightly e2e fail after token expiry.
cleo: simple SDK change: accept optional credentialProvider callback (sync/async). SDK calls provider on init and again if a request gets 401, then retries once. mirrors AWS-like pattern.
peggy: include small helpers for AWS/GCP secret manager in sample apps so users have examples.
infra-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/934 — "canonicalize auth envs + credentialProvider API" (created by infra-bot)
dan: short term: add deprecation warnings for RW_API_KEY/RW_TOKEN and add a CLI lint that flags non-canonical env names in sample repos.
cleo: I'll open a tiny python PR to accept both names with a deprecation log, and file an RFC for the provider API.
peggy: I'll draft the devportal doc "Auth env precedence & rotation" with sed snippets to migrate .env files.
dan: timeline: doc + lint + sample updates in 2 weeks, SDK provider across languages in 4 weeks, deprecation removal in 6 months.
cleo: thanks — assigning tasks and will post PR links here. :thumbsup:
